# Bounded owner default with a long result

A genuine Kotlin all-compatibility default takes the same nominally bounded
owner formal in three slots and returns long. Frozen virtual and static
compatibility calls, reflection and method handles compare original and
recovered programs. The static accessor bypasses an override while duration
and velocity calls in the original body remain virtual.

Long extrema, independently set high bits, ordered effects, input identity,
nulls and every failure site are checked, along with all original definitions,
complete Signatures, Exceptions and runtime metadata after explicitly reported
helpers and flags. Four independent wrong programs must fail the observer.
The nominal bound is also tested as an unchanged dependency declaration.
